Natore MP blamed for calling AL leader Razakar
2017-11-01T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Natore
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/natore-mp-blamed-calling-al-leader-razakar-1484479

Leaders of Natore Awami League (AL) and its youth wing Jubo League yesterday condemned local lawmaker Shafiqul Islam Shimul for branding veteran freedom fighter Sajedur Rahman Khan as 'Razakar'.

They also urged the Prime Minister to take action against lawmaker  Shimul at a press conference at Natore Press Club.

Sajedur, also chairman of Natore district council, said Shimul called him a Razakar at Natore Circuit House while exchanging views with Primary and Mass Education Minister Mostafizur Rahman Fizar on Friday.

Natore Sadar Upazila Chairman Shariful Islam Ramzan, also joint secretary of district AL, read out a written statement during the occasion.
